Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL213 (Beta-1 adrenergic receptor). Filter to exact measurements (standard_relation equals '=') and require pChEMBL value not null. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary; join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Order rows by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
